> **How to use this.** Read the prompt, work it on paper, *then* expand the solution. Each block escalates Easy → Medium → Hard → Twist. The "Twist" problems are where students lose points on the actual exam — they hide a sign flip, a units mismatch, or a regime change inside a familiar setup.

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Notation crib (click to expand)

Bars over autonomous variables: $\overline{C_0}, \overline{T}, \overline{I}, \overline{G}, \overline{X}, \overline{M}$. MPC = $c$. Expenditure multiplier $K_X = \Delta Y^\ast / \Delta \overline{X}$. Required reserve ratio = $rrr$. Money multiplier $K_S = 1/rrr$. Exchange rate $E_{\$/\pounds}$ quoted as **dollars per pound** throughout.
:::
